You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def analyze(I,O):
    I=np.array(I);O=np.array(O)
    res={}
    for v in np.unique(I):
        if v:
            cs=cc(I==v)  # 4-conn comps as frozensets of abs pts
            cs=[set(c) for c in cs]
            outpos=set(zip(*np.where(O==v)))
            # lower comp: the one whose final BL row is 9 (flush bottom)
            info=[]
            for c in cs:
                # find its final placement: match norm
                n=min((y-x[0],x[1]-x[0]) for y,x in []) 
                ys=[p[0] for p in c]; xs=[p[1] for p in c]
                normc=frozenset((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in c)
                # candidate final positions: all translations placing norm inside grid and cells==v in O
                cand=[]
                h=max(y for y,x in normc); w=max(x for y,x in normc)
                for r in range(10-h):
                    for cl in range(10-w):
                        pts={(r+y,cl+x) for y,x in normc}
                        if all(0<=a<10 and 0<=b<10 and O[a,b]==v for a,b in pts) \
                           and len(pts&outpos)==len(pts):
                            cand.append((pts,(r,cl)))
                # pick placement whose cells == full comp (unique per comp)
                ok=[c2 for c2,_ in cand if c2==c]
                assert len(ok)==1, (v,len(c),len(cand))
                c2,_=ok[0]
                bl=(min(p[0] for p in c2), min(p[1] for p in c2))
                h=max(p[0] for p in c)-min(p[0] for p in c)+1
                info.append((bl,h))
            return info

import numpy as np
def cc(mask):
    seen=np.zeros_like(mask); out=[]
    for i in range(10):
        for j in range(10):
            if mask[i,j] and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i,j]=1; comp=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<10 and 0<=nx<10 and mask[ny,nx] and not seen[ny,nx]:
                            seen[ny,nx]=1; st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(comp)
    return out
def f(I):
    g=[[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
    info={}
    for v in np.unique(np.array(I)):
        if v==0: continue
        comps=[set(c) for c in cc(np.array(I)==v)]
        info[int(v)]=comps

def f(gin):
    H,W=len(gin),len(gin[0])
    g=[row[:] for row in gin]
    # components of whole grid (any color), connected if same color
    mask=np.array(gin)!=0
    seen=np.zeros(mask.shape,bool); comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if mask[i,j] and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i,j]=True; c=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); c.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and mask[ny,nx] and not seen[ny,nx]:
                            seen[ny,nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append(c)
    # group by color, order colors by leftmost appearance
    groups={}
    for c in comps:
        v=gin[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
        groups.setdefault(v,[]).append(c)
    cols_sorted=sorted(groups,key=lambda v:min(min(q[1] for q in cs) for cs in groups[v]))
    L,R=cols_sorted[0],cols_sorted[-1]
    def stack(comps,X):
        s=sorted(comps,key=len,reverse=True)
        X0=X
        for idx,c in enumerate(s):
            ys=[q[0] for q in c]; h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1
            top=9-h
            for y,x in c: g[top+y-min(ys)][X0+x-min(min(q[1] for q in c))] = None
        return s
    # clearer implementation below
    def place(comps,X):
        s=sorted(comps,key=len,reverse=True)
        X0=min(min(q[1] for q in c) for c in comps)
        for idx,c in enumerate(s):
            ys=[q[0] for q in c]; xs=[q[1] for q in c]
            h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1
            top=9-h
            for y,x in c: g[top+(y-min(ys))][X0+(x-min(xs))]=gin[y][x]
        return
    mx=max(max(q[1] for c in groups[L] for q in c))
    place(groups[L],0)
    place(groups[R],mx+2)
    return g
for p in ['1','2','3','4']:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    r=f(gi)
    print(p, r==go)

import numpy as np
def cc(g):
    m=np.array(g)!=0; seen=np.zeros(m.shape,bool); out=[]
    for i in range(m.shape[0]):
        for j in range(m.shape[1]):
            if m[i,j] and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i,j]=True; cur=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cur.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<m.shape[0] and 0<=nx<m.shape[1] and m[ny,nx] and not seen[ny,nx]:
                            seen[ny,nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(cur)
    return out
for p in ['1','2','3','4']:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']
    groups={}
    for c in cc(gi): groups.setdefault(gi[c[0][0]][c[0][1]],[]).append(c)
    left=min(groups,key=lambda k:min(min(x for _,x in c) for c in groups[k]))
    right=[k for k in groups if k!=left][0]
    go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    oc=cc(go)
    print('pair',p,'LEFT comps:')
    for c in sorted(groups[left],key=lambda c:min(y for y,_ in c)):
        ys=[y for y,_ in c]; xs=[x for _,x in c]
        col=gi[ys[0]][xs[0]]
        tt=(min(ys),min(xs))
        rel=[(y-tt[0],x-tt[1]) for y,x in c]
        h=max(r for r,_ in rel)+1; wd=max(d for _,d in rel)+1
        print('   color',col,'TL',tt,'dims',(h,wd),'size',len(c))
    print('   RIGHT comps:')
    for c in sorted(groups[right],key=lambda c:min(y for y,_ in c)):
        ys=[y for y,_ in c]; xs=[x for _,x in c]
        col=gi[ys[0]][xs[0]]
        tt=(min(ys),min(xs))
        rel=[(y-tt[0],x-tt[1]) for y,x in c]
        h=max(r for r,_ in rel)+1; wd=max(d for _,d in rel)+1
        print('   color',col,'TL',tt,'dims',(h,wd),'size',len(c))
    print('   OUT bands:')
    for c in sorted(oc,key=lambda c:min(y for y,_ in c)):
        col=go[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
        ys=[y for y,_ in c]; xs=[x for _,x in c]
        tt=(min(ys),min(xs))
        rel=[(y-tt[0],x-tt[1]) for y,x in c]
        h=max(r for r,_ in rel)+1; wd=max(d for _,d in rel)+1
        print('   color',col,'TL',tt,'dims',(h,wd),'size',len(c))
